Net 2,372,753 = gap. Budgetary vs GAAP; no missing or duplicate line.

Statement p5 Issuance of Debt 20,285,000 (City Highway Allocation column only); JSON debt_proceeds 20,285,000 + other_financing 194,974 (Leases 8,196 + Premium on Bonds 175,527 + Insurance Proceeds 11,251) = 20,479,974. The only remaining difference is 195,000: Special Assessments debt proceeds printed on the budgetary-basis schedule p16, while the GAAP statement p5 prints '-' for Special Assessments issuance. Both printed; no fix.

Statement p5 General column prints 'Leases' 8,196 under Other Financing Sources (Uses); it is not in detail (the General budgetary schedule p10 prints no lease row, so the money is in no existing detail line: lease recognition is a GAAP non-cash entry).
